title: South Facade
notes: Three stepped volumes and a chimney wall
address: Bosques de las Lomas, Mexico City

detail.intro: The south elevation is drawn as three volumes stepping up from left to right, closed with a tall chimney wall. The windows are few and square, cut deep into the mass. A low terrace wall runs across the front.

blocks.html: [Photographs of the south side of the house still to come.]
